name: Multi-echo MR — one display set for each echo time
notes: A single-frame MR series that holds more than one EchoTime gives one
display set for each EchoTime, with the description
`<SeriesDescription> TE=<EchoTime>`. The slices of each display set are in
the order of their position along the normal of the image plane.
`isMultiEcho` is a series value: the images of the series have two or more
echo times. A series with one echo time keeps the default display sets.
Multi-frame instances (for example an Enhanced MR instance with more than
one echo) stay with the default `multiFrame` rule. A split of the frames of
one instance needs a change to the rule language.
Priority -1: the rule runs before every default rule.

multiEchoByEchoTime.description: Single-frame MR with two or more echo times: one display set for each EchoTime.
